'''Fala''' was the daughter of the [[Sedrian]] [[bishop of war]], [[Karak]].

==Biography==
Fala was the daughter of [[Karak]], [[bishop of war]] to the [[Priests of the Sun]] and later leader of his own [[Karak's renegades|group of dissidents]]. When she was younger, Fala and [[Pek]], son of [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] [[Cardo (Sedrian)|Cardo]], were involved in a romance. Fala supported her father's beliefs that [[Sedrian]] society and its relationship to the [[Golden Sun]] had to be reformed. However, unlike her father, Fala truly believed in these ideals, and did not crave power for herself. She was largely unaware of Karak's grander plans to obtain power on Sedri.<ref name="BGS" />

When an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] team went to the [[Karak's settlement|settlement]] to find the missing [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] [[Mors Odrion]], Fala greeted them cautiously. The Alliance team managed to convince Fala that her father was in league with the Galactic Empire, which caused Fala and many of the renegades to recant their support for Karak. During the [[Battle of Fitsay]], Fala, Pek and the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Rekara]] assisted the Golden Sun's chosen champion in defeating Karak and freeing the Golden Sun to spread across [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. Fala, alongside Pek, succeeded [[Cardo (Sedrian)|Cardo]] as High Priest.<ref name="BGS" />

==Personality and traits==
Fala was a firm believer in the ideas of societal reform. She would listen to reasonable arguments, but had little patient for stupidity and prejudice.<ref name="BGS" />
